items.title: Why Exxon's Q2 earnings fell short — even despite surging oil prices

items.title: European gas jumps 30% as Iran war strains winter supply
items.summary: Key takeawaysEuropean benchmark gas prices gained more than 30 per cent in July, ending a three-month losing streak. EU gas storage finished the month at roughly 55 per cent capacity, below historical averages and last year’s level.
